I told Marcus in a reply to his message in #north-team that the next renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. is 25 November.

That date comes only from Ilse's 14 October post in #north-team. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he can see it too. Nothing else in the channel mentions a different date. There are no account files I could check it against: the shared accounts folder showed nothing for Brackenwater, or for any account. I suggested he confirm with Ilse if the account sheet needs a contract reference.
